DIAGNOSIS READY: Palmoplantar Pustulosis (associated with psoriasis or chronic exposure).

The combination of a longstanding pruritic rash on the palms, associated numbness/tingling (likely neuropathic or due to chronic inflammation), a history of farming, and the absence of systemic inflammatory markers or joint swelling strongly suggests a localized dermatologic condition rather than a systemic autoimmune disease like Lupus or Psoriatic Arthritis. The numbness may be a secondary sensory disturbance or related to the specific location of the dermatitis. No further tests are required at this time.
